findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 8 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The book calls [a, b] an open interval. [a, b] is the closed interval; the open interval is ]a, b[ (also written (a, b)). The theorem should end: "... has at least one real root c in the open interval ]a, b[." A full stop is also missing after "closed interval [a, b]" before "If".
